question: The value of 15 of 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4] is:
solution:
Given:

15 of 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7a9b9173e89d44a854cc9c8053cf1e4425472078909d5687a2dfa61a2ec670c.png] 

Calculation:

15 of 8 - 6 + [(27 - 3) ÷ 6 - 4]

⇒ 120 - 6 + [24 ÷ 6 - 4]

⇒ 120 - 6 + [4 - 4]

​⇒ 120 - 6 + 0

⇒ 114

**∴ The required answer is 114.**
